clue: Some came here to cut cakes,
some to catch up over food,
and some arrived dressed up for an afternoon with the ladies.
Plates got lighter, glasses got emptier,
but the conversations only grew louder.
To reach the place you seek, let the number of seasons guide your rise.
Find the place. Your next clue is waiting around there.
task: PARTY FREEZE!!
Once you reach the location, recreate a party scene using your entire team.
One teammate must pretend to cut a cake, one must raise an imaginary toast, and the others must strike their most creative celebration poses.
Everyone must be visible in a single group photo.
The funnier and more dramatic the picture, the better!
Send your Party Freeze photo to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion :-).

clue: Your next destination is where people enter and leave the community.
But which one?
Your hand carries the answer.
Count what nature gave it, and let that number guide you.
Reach the right spot. Your next clue is waiting there.
task: Obtain a receipt/bill generated after 7:00 PM today, clearly showing the current date and time.
Click a selfie with all team members, with the receipt clearly visible from the above location.
Send the photo to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: My name is Anahat Singh.
If Swetha Shubham were my home, there is one place I would keep returning to.
Here, a wall is not a boundary but a partner.
What you send away often comes racing back.
Two may enter to compete, but the walls play along too.
Find my favourite place. Your next clue is waiting there.
task: TASK: HUMAN ALPHABET CHALLENGE!
Once you reach the location, it’s time to spell your identity!
Using your team members, form the FIRST ALPHABET of your Team Name.
Everyone except the photographer must be part of the formation.
Think creatively and capture the formation from an aerial/top-view angle so the alphabet is clearly visible.
No normal group photo allowed!
Send your Human Alphabet photo to the Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: I don’t belong to any one flat,
yet I deal with matters of them all.
Requests, records and resident concerns
often find their way to my door.
Find me. Your next clue is waiting there.
task: Record a video of one team member cycling continuously for at least 30 seconds.
Then click a selfie with your entire team and the cycle.
Send both the video and team photo to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: I notice those who come and go.
I stay alert while others relax.
I watch without wandering,
and keeping the society safe is my everyday job.
Find where I belong. Your next clue is waiting there.
task: 21st June celebrates an ancient practice that India shared with the world.
Solve what it is, then bring the one thing you would normally unroll before beginning the practice.
Get 3 team members into a blissful pose with your newly found companion.
Click a picture and send it to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: I hold plenty, yet I am never thirsty.
People come to me to move, yet often remain in the same place.
Some race across me, some simply float,
and the deeper you go, the quieter the world becomes.
Find me. Your next clue is waiting around me.
task: Once you reach the location, line up the entire team beside it.
Create a Human Wave: Starting from one end, each teammate must raise and lower both hands one after another, creating one continuous wave across the team.
🎥 Record the complete wave in a single continuous video.
Bonus: End the wave with the entire team shouting HUNT ON!
Send the video to the Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: I have many seats, but no dining table.
Everyone faces one direction, but no teacher stands there.
Sometimes I am silent, sometimes I come alive with a crowd.
I have no roof to hide under, yet I was made to bring people together.
Find me. Your next clue is waiting there.
task: Once you reach the right place, your challenge begins.
Capture pictures of 3 different cars belonging to the same brand.
There is one catch: at least one teammate must appear in every picture.
Once all 3 are captured, send the complete set of photos to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: I hold something everyone needs,
yet no one comes here to drink from me.
I quietly keep a reserve for hundreds of homes,
while the taps far above depend on me.
But don’t look towards the sky for me.
From where the cars rest, let twice below zero guide your way.
Figure out this place.
Your next clue is waiting around there.
task: Find 2 different varieties of something that:
I grow from a flower.
I may hide one seed or many.
I can be juicy, pulpy, sweet or tangy.
And once I ripen, I rarely stay uneaten for long.
Got them?
Now head to the destination you decoded.
Take a picture with your entire team at the destination, with both varieties clearly visible.
Send the photo to your Hunt Master as proof of task completion.

clue: Eight green corners are scattered around your community. Your mission is to leave none of them unexplored.
Some may look familiar, some may make you pause
But only one among them guards what you seek
task: Visit all eight parks in the community.
Click a group selfie with the entire team at each park.
That means eight parks = eight team selfies.
Send all eight photos to the Hunt Master, find the hidden clue, and continue your hunt.

clue: I am available 365 days a year, quietly watching over you all.
Before a new beginning, journey, or important mission, many come looking for my blessing and sign-off.
I’m not on Teams, I never reply to emails, and you’ll never find my name in an approval workflow.
The first approver of every good beginning awaits.
Figure out who I am and find my shrine.
task: Don’t arrive empty-handed!
Find something colourful and fragrant that grows on a plant and bring enough for every team member.
Once you find the First Approver, record one continuous team video where each team member, one by one, makes an offering.
Everyone must participate. No skipping! 🌼
Send the video to the Hunt Master as your final proof.
final: Your hunt for today is complete!
Head back and take some well-earned rest, but don’t disappear without informing the Hunt Master. :-)
